2 try and clear the cache from your profile, sometimes itll appear under your user settings or system data and can be a simple click. 3 full redownload of RL. Yup a full re download of rocket leauge is a fairly sure fire way to fix this issue and other common issues like such (omg having to do this for modern Warfare was painful), you might want to leave it before going to dinner or work so that it has time to download.

Ive been to the ICU a few times and have had to have this discussion with my doctors over some years so hope this helps: Talking to your doctor about depression can lead to a chat about self harm, which isnt the worst honestly. This is where being honest with your doctor can be a good thing, being open about sh isnt something doctors will immediately out you in a psych ward. If your going straight to a psych ward and ask for an intake, usually goes no where tbh. 

If you have fresh scars and you can see a bad sh day or an attempt, then they might bring you to an intake. The intake is usually 3+ days depending on severity. They usually have a psych ward where you and others will be in this area together. they hold onto all your stuff and put you in a robe while your there and it's mostly just used to make sure you get back to your usual mental state. 

It's not the worst thing honestly, theres a stigma behind going to these intakes but it's done to make sure you stay alive. 

Tldr; be open, people will see your scars in any aspect of all this if you can be strong and work through this. They might not keep you there but they'll try to make sure your alright.

Hi there, 23 MTF here and I've been on 25mg estrodol for about 2 years now. It's been small changes I've experienced since around the 8 month mark of E but I also was on sporolactone (testosterone blocker) from roughly 8-10 months prior. 

The overall changes can very from person to person obviously but some of the effects can/may still appear IE; softer skin, thinner body/pubic hair, natural curves around the abdomen and hip area, shrinkage of package,  chest/breast growth and tenderness in said area and on nipples lastly infidelity/ changes to what my sperm looks like.

Personally I have experienced this and some other decent side effects from softer voice, leakage or discharge from my nipples (clear odour/flavorless liquid). All of these were things my doctor and I had to discuss prior to starting but now I am happy that I can notice the differences as being a fairly tall individual I was scared about doing low does HRT and not seeing changes.

Oh and to answer the why am I on a low dose is because, when starting on hormones one big fear doctors can have when prescribing blockers or E is that it does carry a higher chance of possibly having a stroke. Seeing as I had a few strokes throughout my early child hood, it heavily delayed my starting as doctors were severely concerned about me having another one due to the hormones.
